patch_description: The current agent uses slow/fast learning decays of .992/.88, likelihood tempering of .8, four routing horizons, and two-step local control. This version retains the recovery expert and adds censored-observation learning, information-weighted updates, and three-step survival-conditioned control. Intermediate targets receive a completion reward once, followed by safety checks and a bounded onward-route potential; only escape is terminal. Local risk weights become 92, .58, and .27 across the three steps, with a three-candidate second-step beam. These changes aim to reduce collisions around keys and frontiers while preserving progress. Performance remains to be measured.
